dedupe_keys.name: hourly energy consumption of the benguerir experimental open pit mine stations

description: This IEEE DataPort dataset gives hourly energy consumption, functioning hours and a production KPI for stations of the experimental open-pit mine at Benguerir in Morocco, mainly the destoning, screening and train loading stations. The page says the energy data come from power meters stored in a database with functioning hours and production, and that the files also hold an example of the FFQR forecasting algorithm and an API to test it; it supports the 2022 paper by Laayati, Bouzi and Chebak on a smart energy management and peak load forecasting system for an open-pit mine (Applied System Innovation). It was created on 3 February 2022 and last updated on 20 February 2022 by Oussama Laayati of the Green Tech Institute, Mohammed VI Polytechnic University, as CSV, text and video files under CC BY 4.0 according to the DataCite record. The page marks it a Standard Dataset, so the files need an IEEE DataPort subscription (US$40 a month on the subscribe page, free for IEEE Society members). Coverage is one mine site. Caveats: the time span, and the number of rows are not stated on the page read, and the data are called an example, so they may be a subset. For simulation it gives measured process-stage loads for mine electricity demand models, peak shaving and demand response at extraction sites, and for estimating how supply interruptions stop mineral processing and rail loading. Related catalogue records include the VEA industrial load profiles, OMSES_DE mine energy supply model and the Energy and Industry Facilities Composite.
